Ines Fujin has the time of her life<n>racing against
her rival at the<n>Takarazuka Kinen. Relishing the feel
of the breeze, all she wants to do is<n>run some
more—

That is, until she sees Mejiro Ryan<n>expressing her
gratitude to the crowd.<n>Scrambling to thank her own
fans too,<n>Ines promises to keep working hard<n>to live
up to their expectations.

She tells me that she hopes to make<n>her next race
another that will make<n>her supporters happy.

There's no doubt in my mind that<n>what her fans
really want is to see<n>her having a great time on the
track,<n>and the autumn Tenno Sho is a race<n>she'll
definitely enjoy!
